item.title: Stay Mild, But You’re Not Getting A Mild
item.description: Read Stay Mild, But You’re Not Getting A Mild Me: "I'm sorry, sir. Because you're buying this for someone else, I can't sell it to you." Customer: "I'm not buying it for someone else." Me: "I could hear you on the phone." Read Stay Mild, But You’re Not Getting A Mild

item.title: When You’re A PHENOMENON
item.description: Read When You’re A PHENOMENON Regular: "Wow! Who was that?!" Me: "My boyfriend's ex." Regular: "Your boyfriend was with her… before he was with you?!" Read When You’re A PHENOMENON

item.title: Maybe They Were Dust Bunnies?
item.description: Read Maybe They Were Dust Bunnies? Boss: "You got this ticket to repair this computer?" Me: "Clean it. The customer wanted it dusted out." Boss: "You returned it uncleaned?" Read Maybe They Were Dust Bunnies?

item.title: Hungry For The Past
item.description: Read Hungry For The Past Customer: "Can I get [Burger]?" Me: "Uh, I don't think I know that one. What's on it?" Customer: "Are you new? You should know what's on it! You have a coupon for it!" Read Hungry For The Past

item.title: Don’t Throw Rainbow Cats In Glass Houses
item.description: Read Don’t Throw Rainbow Cats In Glass Houses Owner: "Come on [Regular's Name]. It's just a cartoon cat." Regular: "And it's trying to be cute while portraying immoral values, and I will not—" Owner: "—Matthew 5:32." Regular: *Closes mouth, but glares at [Owner].* Read Don’t Throw Rainbow Cats In Glass Houses
